anas_prep_today: Anas (Yale SOM MBA, recruiting for investment banking) prepares for technicals with the Finance Club's technical-session prep guides, Breaking Into Wall Street and Wall Street Prep questions, the 400 Questions IB guide, second-year MBA students as mock-interview partners, Yale's Career Development Office coaches, and an AI chat assistant. He spends roughly 15 hours a week on technicals and has not paid for any of it, because Yale provides these resources. In his words, nothing frustrates him about it so far.
